rows.description: Runs the envsetup session ritual and produces its artifacts: `/session start` reads the docs system in full (OVERVIEW, the newest SES, CONTEXT.md, the area's ADRs/analyses/plan), checks the tree against the session log, creates this conversation's docs/sessions/SES-NNN file and posts a brief; `/session entry` after every commit appends and fills the commit's entry, updates OVERVIEW/ADR/PRD/CONTEXT.md where the change made them stale, and commits it as docs(session); `/session end` verifies the log is complete, Status is current and the tree is clean. Use at the start of a conversation in this repo, right after each commit, and before finishing. Not for authoring the docs themselves (an ADR, the PRD, an analysis, the glossary — those have their own skills), not for driving the CLI (the run skills), and not for running, changing or testing the session tool itself (`scripts/session.ts`: the run-scripts skill; questions about it: docs/sessions/README.md).

Use for the envsetup session ritual — the docs/sessions log this repo keeps so each conversation picks up where the last left off. Invoke when: a conversation in this repo opens (`start`: read OVERVIEW, newest SES, CONTEXT.md, the area's ADRs/plan in full, create this conversation's SES-NNN, post a brief); a commit just landed or several went unlogged (`entry`: fill the entry, refresh stale OVERVIEW/CONTEXT/PRD, commit as docs(session)); the user is wrapping up or leaving (`end`: log complete, Status current, tree clean); or a release tag needs its marker. Also use for questions about the ritual's rules: what the gate's warnings or NOT ready mean, which session file is yours vs. another conversation's, whether to touch someone else's placeholders, what an entry must contain. Not for authoring the docs themselves (ADR, PRD, analysis, glossary have their own skills), not for driving the CLI (run skills), and not for debugging or changing the session tool's code (`scripts/session.ts`, its flags, its tests: run-scripts skill).

Use to perform the envsetup session ritual — the docs/sessions log each conversation resumes from. Trigger on: a conversation opening in this repo (`start`: read OVERVIEW, newest SES, CONTEXT.md, the area's ADRs/plan in full, create this conversation's SES-NNN, post a brief); a commit just landed or several unlogged (`entry`: fill the entry, refresh stale OVERVIEW/CONTEXT/PRD, commit as docs(session)); wrapping up or leaving (`end`: log complete, Status current, tree clean); a release tag needing its marker. Also for questions about the ritual's rules: what the gate's warnings or NOT ready mean, which SES file is yours, whether to touch another conversation's placeholders, what an entry must contain. Not for making the ritual fire automatically (hooks, settings, startup automation: update-config), authoring the docs themselves (ADR, PRD, analysis, glossary have their own skills), driving the CLI (run skills), or debugging/changing `scripts/session.ts`, its flags, tests (run-scripts).
